title: Emil and the Detectives
author: Erich Kästner
short_summary: Young Emil Tischbein travels alone by train to Berlin carrying money his mother has saved for his grandmother, only to have it stolen by a suspicious man while he sleeps. Too ashamed to go to the police, Emil teams up with a gang of Berlin street kids led by a boy named Gustav to track down the thief themselves.
extended_summary:
Emil Tischbein has never been to Berlin before, but he's making the trip alone to visit his grandmother, carrying an envelope of money his hardworking mother has scraped together. On the train, a strange man named Grundeis seems friendly enough, but after Emil falls asleep, he wakes up to find the money gone and the man vanished at the next stop. Ashamed of an earlier prank that once got him in trouble with the police back home, Emil decides not to report the theft to the authorities and instead follows Grundeis through the unfamiliar streets of Berlin on his own.

He doesn't stay alone for long. A cheerful, resourceful Berlin boy named Gustav, famous for the car horn he carries everywhere, quickly rounds up an entire gang of local children willing to help a stranger in trouble. Together the children organize a real detective operation — trailing Grundeis in relay shifts, gathering evidence, and finally cornering him at a bank, where they discover the thief is wanted by the police for an entirely different, much bigger crime. Emil gets his money back, earns new friends, and proves that a group of ordinary kids working together can outsmart a grown criminal.
